∀ (p : outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.Public) (st : outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.State p)
  (G : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat p.m p.n),
  outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.step p st G =
    if st.seen = false ∨ OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm G ≤ st.score then
      { point := st.point - outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stepSize p • OracleTemplate.Muon.orthogonalize G,
        best := st.point, score := OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm G, seen := true }
    else
      { point := st.point - outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.stepSize p • OracleTemplate.Muon.orthogonalize G,
        best := st.best, score := st.score, seen := true }
